Age of CrownsRealm of the Four Crowns

Four mouse kingdoms share one great mainland and a scatter of islands, from roaring capitals to sleepy fishing villages. Swear to a crown and carry a musket in its army, or stay free and trade cheese for pearls across the sea. Sail between the kingdoms, explore the islands, and take to the skies in royal balloons.
